params.body:
## What Ilse saw

Creating a vehicle of type "enkel overnamedocumenten" from the order form ("Overname wagen" > "nieuwe wagen"): the field "Originele eigenaar" was nowhere on the sheet, yet saving refused with "Nog 1 verplicht veld niet ingevuld: Relation name". Ilse (17 September 2026): the field must be filled for a bidding vehicle and for a takeover-documents vehicle alike, and started from the order form it must be prefilled with the relation of that order.

## Why

The relation picker in the shared `general` partial carries the class `export_vehicle_only`, and `refresh.css` hides that class under `.ui-vtype-2` (the Livewire sheet's type class). The classic form set `for_export` to 1 for type 2 (same JS branch as a bidding vehicle) and so showed the block and required the owner; the Livewire sheet keeps `for_export` 0 on type 2, so a type 2 chosen on the sheet had neither field nor rule, while a type 2 seeded from the order form (`OwnStockController::create` sets `for_export` 1 when `original_owner_id` travels along) had the rule and no field. The banner named the input (`relation_name`) because `fieldLabels()` had no name for it.

## What changed

- `VehicleRequest::requiresOriginalOwner(data)`: `relation_name` is required on `for_export` 1 **or** `vehicle_type` 2. Type 0 unchanged.
- `VehicleForm::showsOriginalOwner()` decides server-side whether the block renders on the Livewire sheet (types 1 and 2); the block drops `export_vehicle_only` there so `refresh.css` cannot hide it. The classic form is untouched (still the JS toggle). No hot file touched.
- The banner and the inline message say "Originele eigenaar" (`fieldLabels`, `validation.attributes` in nl/en/fr/de).
- From the order form the relation was already seeded into the draft; `VehicleForm::orderOriginNote()` now says under the field for which order ("Overname voor de bestelbon van Jeep Renegade; ..."), in four languages.
- R S1-1.2 extended; decision `klant:beslissingen#originele-eigenaar-overnamedocumenten` with Ilse's words; finding `bevindingen/2026-09-17-originele-eigenaar-overnamedocumenten.md` (opgelost).

## Tests

`VehicleFormOriginalOwnerTest` (rule for the three types; type 2 shows the picker, requires it, banner names the field, jumps to Algemeen, saves once picked; type 1 unchanged; type 0 no picker; from the order form prefilled and the order named, through the real `ownvehicle.create` seeding). The type-2 save test in `VehicleFormSaveTest` now picks an owner first.

Run: `VehicleForm*` + `OrderTakeoverReturnTest` (43 tests), `RulesCoverageTest|RulesIdentityTest|RulesSourcesTest|LanguageParityTest` (15, 1 pre-existing incomplete), `SmokeTest` (263), `AlpineExpressionTest|HandlerWiringTest|CompiledViewsTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest` (12). All green.

## Open point (not in this PR)

A type 2 chosen on the sheet keeps `for_export` 0 and therefore gets the own-vehicle rules (weight and emission required), where the classic form with `for_export` 1 did not ask for them. Whether type 2 should carry `for_export` 1 as before is a question for Shane; noted in the finding.
params.title: Vehicle form: 'Originele eigenaar' on a takeover-documents vehicle, prefilled from the order
